_doc: Per-archetype role frequencies from extracted/smogon-dump. `carry` = share of teams with >=1 set covering the role; `mean` = sets per team; `offence` = mean EV offence share (team_shape.offence_pct). Archetype columns are AUTHOR-TAGGED teams only (team_tags.py), singles only, six-mon teams only. `mode` columns are author-tagged AND agreement-validated teams (team_tags.agreement): `setter_mean` = sets per team carrying the mode's own move, `abuser_mean` = sets per six that CASH the mode (setter evidence stripped) and `abuser_base` the same over the whole corpus, `payoff` move, `payoff` = moves the mode over-represents by 5.0x (weather only), `type_lift` = P(type | mode teams) / P(type | all teams) over the 66% of corpus sets whose species exists in Realidea's dex.

sample._doc: 2000 real teams drawn from `all`, each [hazards, removal, setup, pivot, recovery, speed, priority, status, protect, phaze, screens, sun, rain, sand, snow, trickroom, offence]. Fixed seed.
